people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
translations.bsb: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
translations.asv: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
